world.title: Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack
world.description: A drone carrying an explosive device was discovered at the airport close to Ukrainian cargo planes on 4 August.

world.title: Iran retaliates after US strikes kill four at wedding party, state media reports
world.description: Iranian news agencies said retaliatory missile and drone attacks on US targets had begun.

world.title: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
world.description: As of August, the number forced to return this year from Pakistan and Iran had reached another million.

world.title: River water smashed into tunnel and chased me for 20 minutes, Nepal worker tells BBC
world.description: Major efforts to rescue hydropower workers continue as Nepal's death toll exceeds 1,000.

world.title: Sexual assaults happening almost every day in Ceuta, prosecutors say
world.description: Most migrants have returned to neighbouring Morocco, but as many as 5,000 remain in the Spanish exclave.

world.title: Jurors in Lindsay Clancy trial deadlocked but judge asks them to keep trying
world.description: The Massachusetts mother is facing murder charges for killing her three children at their family home in 2023.

world.title: Ariana Grande completes tour and steps back from public life
world.description: The star makes an emotional farewell as she wraps up a tour she's described as her "last hurrah".

world.title: Pistol in a lake gives hope for French cold case
world.description: Saad al-Hilli was shot dead with his wife and mother-in-law while holidaying in eastern France in September 2012.

world.title: As Michigan Senate race heats up, Vance calls El-Sayed 'evil'
world.description: El-Sayed faces Trump ally Mike Rogers in what has quickly become a senate race characterised by personal attacks and insults between the two.

world.title: France targets Shein and Temu with fast fashion fees
world.description: The levy on "ultra-fast fashion" items could reach almost €20 per garment by 2030.

world.title: 'I have fired 40 of my agents for being corrupt', says Nigeria's anti-corruption chief
world.description: The EFCC boss says more than five of the dismissed officials are already facing prosecution.

world.title: Israel says Hamas security chief captured as strikes kill four during Gaza raid
world.description: The Israeli military says it carried out strikes in Gaza City during a raid by special forces to capture the head of Hamas's internal security service.

world.title: Trump says US position on Falklands 'one of many' under review
world.description: The UK says Falkland islanders "are British with a right to determine their own future".

world.title: Ex-gang boss guilty of orchestrating 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur
world.description: Duane "Keffe D" Davis was convicted over the drive-by shooting of the rap superstar 30 years ago.

world.title: Russian attack hits rail workers in new deadly strikes on Kyiv
world.description: Ukrainian officials say 20 people, including two children, were injured in the capital and the wider region.

US.title: Incumbent Sen. Ed Markey wins Massachusetts' Democratic primary for US Senate
US.description: Bucking a push for younger leadership this election season, Sen. Ed Markey, 80, won the Democratic nomination against Rep. Seth Moulton, 47, who said that his party needed new leaders.

US.title: North Carolina Rep. Chuck Edwards is formally censured over harassment allegations
US.description: The censure vote drew bipartisan support, and followed an investigation by the House Ethics Committee into allegations of sexual harassment against two young female staff members.

US.title: Congress averts a government shutdown ahead of the midterms
US.description: With just a few weeks to spare, the House approved legislation extending funding through mid-December.

US.title: ICE says it has enough body cameras now, after series of deadly shootings
US.description: Cameras could help alleviate some concerns about ICE transparency and accountability after immigration officers were involved in over two dozen shootings under the Trump administration.

US.title: Beloved writer and environmentalist Wendell Berry has died at age 92
US.description: Wendell Berry has died at age 92 He was a beloved American poet, novelist, essayist, and farmer.

US.title: SCOTUS allows Trump's ballroom project to continue. And, the Army secretary resigns
US.description: The Supreme Court has ruled that President Trump's ballroom project may continue. And, Army Secretary Dan Driscoll resigns after 18 months on the job.

US.title: They live by a shrine to a saint. Why are their homes being demolished?
US.description: The neighborhood is a pilgrimage site, with a shrine to the Sufi saint known as Bari Imam. In the past year, hundreds of homes of the working poor were razed. Residents fear more will be demolished.

US.title: Why the Supreme Court's ballroom ruling could matter beyond the ballroom
US.description: Georgetown Law professor Stephen Vladeck explains the separation-of-powers questions raised by the Supreme Court's decision on the White House ballroom.

US.title: USPS 'carefully reviewing' whistleblower claim on plan for Trump's mail in voting order
US.description: A whistleblower says the U.S. Postal Service is rushing out an online system for President Trump's push to restrict mail voting that could "derail" the midterm election if courts allow

US.title: A makeover for college: No gym, no meal plan and two years of work
US.description: A new model in Vermont emphasizes hands-on learning while stripping away frills like gyms and meal plans that increase costs. Other newly created institutions are also reimagining college.
